title: SubagentResource

session_id.description: The ID of the session that owns the subagent.

name.description: The runner-assigned nickname, or null when unavailable.

instructions.description: Initial task content, or null when unavailable. Text may contain placeholders for images or audio when only a preview is available.

parent_agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that created this subagent.

status.description: The current status of the subagent.

opened_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the subagent was first opened. Resuming does not change it.

closed_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the subagent was closed. Null while active, including after resume.

description: A subagent created within a session.
